status: PROPOSED by openspec/changes/damage-control (2026-10-04). No engine code reads this yet; the systems mockup does. Numbers are tuning proposals, not decisions.

units.integrity: percent of a system's full health, 0 to 100
units.rate: percent per second where the key says pct_per_s

hull.note: A hull section is a span between two of the layout's hull sections times one of six faces (9 spans x 6 faces = 54). A fresh section absorbs up to armour_mj of each hit, scaled by its integrity; each hit takes min(E, armour_mj) / section_mj x 100 points of integrity from it.

breach.note: A hit whose energy passes the armour opens a breach in the first compartment it enters, sized by the energy left: 1 MJ past the armour makes 0.02 m^2, 50 MJ makes 1 m^2.

propagation.note: Energy past the armour marches along the hit direction, falling as exp(-s / decay_m) and losing bulkhead_mj at each bulkhead it crosses. In each compartment it crosses, it damages what lies within radius_m + radius_per_sqrt_mj x sqrt(E_deposited) of its path.

systems.note: Integrity points taken = points_per_mj x E_deposited x (1 - d / r). Capability is 1 at or above nominal_from_pct, integrity / nominal_from_pct between the two thresholds, 0 below disabled_below_pct; 0 integrity is destroyed.

nodes.note: A switchboard section, panel or bus loses health as a system does (points / 100); below destroyed_below it carries nothing until rebuilt.

fire.note: Per compartment a hit deposits energy in: ignition chance min(chance_max, chance_per_mj x E) times the room's oxygen factor, decided by a seeded hash of (session seed, hit id, compartment id). The fire starts at fire.seed_kw (atmosphere.json) plus seed_kw_per_mj x E.

crew.note: Every crew member in a compartment the hit deposits energy in loses hp_per_mj x E x share hit points (100 is full health).

patch.note: A crew member patches a breach from inside with plates (cabin pressure presses a plate onto the hole), up to inside_max_m2; a larger breach is closed from outside by a suited crew member through the airlock.

teams.note: NPC damage control teams are crew bodies (crew-on-deck): they walk the crew-portal graph, carry a kit, an extinguisher or plates, take the same harm as players, and can die.
